messages:
Amir: Heads up — during last night's webinar burst 42 VIP leads ended up unassigned for ~10-20m. Looks like enrichment race vs RR priority.
Jules: Can you share an example?
Amir: Sample: hs lead vip-221 created -> enrich webhook accepted (202) -> RR sees vip flag but waits on enrich.score; later enrichment writes score and owner never set because RR slot expired.
Sofia: Sounds like two issues: (1) RR waits on enrichment (blocking), (2) VIP routing path doesn't preempt fallback.
Liam: Quick idea: if lead.vip === true then bypass enrich gating and assign immediately to VIP pool, but mark lead.meta.pre_enrich=true. Add dedupe guard so outreach cadence ignores pre_enrich until enrichment confirms.
Jules: Agree but must avoid reassign churn when enrichment arrives. Rules: if pre_enrich assigned and enrichment returns, only reassign if score_delta > threshold AND owner not engaged.
Amir: Also want connector.enrich_ttl_seconds for non-VIP leads so we don't block RR indefinitely. Default 300s.
Sofia: Telemetry: counter(pre_enrich_assigned), gauge(vip_unowned_count), and alert if vip_unowned_count > 1 for >5m.
Liam: Canary plan: roll VIP bypass to 100% for webinar-sourced leads for 24h with audit logs. For general bypass, start 5% traffic.
Ops-bot: rollout-ticket created: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/leadflow/pulls/2042 -> staging -> canary -> prod.
Jules: Action items: Amir will PR VIP-bypass + meta flag, Liam adds dedupe & reassign logic, Sofia adds metrics & alert, I'll update SDR playbook language. Sync 11am PT tomorrow. :calendar:
